summary: postinstall auto-publishes new npm packages from the installer using a shipped auth token
details: On `npm install`, the package.json postinstall writes a scratch package.json and an.npmrc containing a hardcoded npm `_authToken` (split across two printf arguments to evade naive scanners) into a temporary directory, then runs `npm publish` from that directory to register new `publish-poc-found-<rand>` packages on registry.npmjs.org. The install side-effect hijacks the installer's host, network identity, and the shipped token to perform authenticated writes to the npm registry, polluting it with attacker-named packages attributable to the installing machine. The behavior fires automatically at install time with no user interaction and no documented opt-out.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
